meta_description: Fraserbuild Services transforms bathrooms across Southampton. Full design, installation, and finishing by experienced craftspeople. Get your free quote today.
hero_subhead: From wet rooms to full renovations, Fraserbuild transforms Southampton bathrooms with precision, quality materials, and fair pricing.
services_heading: Complete Bathroom Renovation Services in Southampton
services_subhead: Every bathroom is different. We handle design consultation, installation, plumbing, tiling, and finishing touches under one roof.

services.title: Full Bathroom Renovations
services.desc: Complete strip-out and rebuild with new suite, tiles, flooring, and all plumbing and electrical work. We manage the whole project so you don't have to.

services.title: Wet Room Installation
services.desc: Walk-in showers with proper waterproofing and drainage. Perfect for accessible bathrooms or creating a spa-like feel in tight spaces.

services.title: Bathroom Suite Replacement
services.desc: Replace your bath, shower, toilet, or vanity without major structural work. We handle removal, installation, and all connections.

services.title: Tiling & Wall Finishing
services.desc: Ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, or natural stone tiles laid to perfection. Every job waterproofed properly to prevent future damp problems.

services.title: Plumbing & Heating
services.desc: All pipework, mixer taps, towel rails, and underfloor heating installed to Building Regulations. No improvisation, no shortcuts.

services.title: Bathroom Design Consultation
services.desc: Free initial visit to assess your space, discuss layouts, and suggest fixtures that work for your budget and style. Plans provided before any work starts.

about_pullquote: I build bathrooms the way I'd want mine done — no shortcuts, honest pricing.
about_para_1: Fraserbuild Services was founded in 2012 by Fraser Mitchell, a time-served bathroom fitter tired of seeing poor workmanship and hidden costs in the trade. Starting with just hand tools and a van, we've grown into Southampton's most trusted bathroom renovation team. Every job is overseen personally — we don't farm work out to cowboys.
about_para_2: We've completed over 150 bathroom projects across Southampton, Itchen, and the surrounding areas. Customers come back to us because we finish on time, respect your home, and stand behind every tile and connection. Our quote is our quote — no nasty surprises halfway through.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Fraserbuild

reviews.text: Fraser came and gave us a free design consultation. Showed us how to make our tiny bathroom feel bigger without breaking the bank. The work was spot-on, no mess, finished dead on schedule. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Had a leaking shower tray and cracked tiles. Expected a nightmare but Fraser managed the whole renovation in just over a week. Great lad, honest about costs, quality finish. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Our en-suite was dated and damp. Fraser ripped it out and installed a beautiful walk-in wet room with proper waterproofing. The attention to detail is impressive. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Michael P.
